description: Automatic signing: email a stored recipient a link to store a reusable signature (they verify their email with a one-time code, accept the authorization text and type, draw or upload their signature). The link is valid for 7 days and calling this again replaces a pending request with a new link. Returns the recipient with signature.status 'pending'; once they complete the enrolment the recipient.signature.enrolled webhook fires and envelopes can set autoSign on this recipient. Rejected with a 400 error when the recipient has no email or already has an active stored signature (remove it first with remove_recipient_signature).
name: request_recipient_signature
